variants.shape: A pragmatic armored infantry design with one broad shallow chamfered sand breastplate, modest squared shoulder caps, visible graphite waist and joints, reinforced thigh and shin plates. Short conventional box-magazine automatic shotgun, simple solid stock, one barrel, robust straight handguard.
